newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian economic prospects good - Costello.
newsitem.headline: Australian economic prospects good - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday that Australia's economic prospects over the next year were good.

"There are very good prospects in the Australian economy," Costello told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio. "As you see, low interest rates, low inflation, growth, exports, investment -- all that's adding up to a very positive year ahead of us."
He declined to comment directly on interest rates. "Well, perhaps I'll take the fifth," he said, referring to the U.S. constitutional guarantee against self-incrimination.
There have been four interest rate cuts in Australia since July 1996 and there is speculation of a fifth.
In its budget for the fiscal year from July, released last month, the government projected economic growth of 3.75 percent in 1997/98, up from 3.25 percent in 1996/97.
The Reserve Bank has cut official cash rates 2.0 percentage points to 5.5 percent in four separate equal cuts from July last year to May this year.
Economists, citing weak economic data including continuing high unemployment, are increasingly expecting another cut.
